summary: IBN Biz Lunch - Arden is a monthly open-invite business networking lunch at Wild Wing Cafe in Arden, NC, run by Incredible Towns of WNC. Both the Eventbrite listings and the parent organization's page explicitly disclaim any membership, dues, fees, or attendance requirements, matching the open drop-in format found for the other IBN chapters (Asheville West, Brevard/Pisgah Forest, East Asheville, Woodfin).

evidence.note: 2026-09-15 listing: 'An open-invite business lunch meetup for locals and professionals... No dues or membership requirements, making it easy to drop in.'
2024-01-16 listing repeats identical language: 'open to all. Never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements.'

Parent org page for the IBN chapter network states the Arden lunch is 'no cost to attend and open to all, with no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions,' describing all chapters as free inclusive networking rather than membership organizations.

Sibling IBN chapters (Asheville West, Brevard/Pisgah Forest, East Asheville, Woodfin) were independently evaluated by other evidence agents as not_group (0.65-0.85) for the same drop-in structure; Arden's evidence is consistent with that finding.
